facts.fact: Home Affairs' Online Verification Service checks identities against the National Population Register in real time in seconds, with uptime upgraded to 99%, says Minister Leon Schreiber.
Network operators, banks and other companies use Home Affairs' Online Verification Service to verify their customers' identities, per BusinessTech reporting the ACT's statements.

ZAF.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
A new Digital Identity system is mentioned but no national digital strategy.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Cost of maintaining and upgrading the system is mentioned but no operator, staff or ownership is stated.
No public register keyed on the national number is described.
Smart ID is mentioned only as a service at bank branches; nothing on uniqueness, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Network operators, banks and other companies verify customers' identities through Home Affairs' Online Verification Service; the fee per check rose from 15 cents to R10 in July 2025, per BusinessTech.
Mobile network operators (SIM verification under RICA) and banks both verify customers against Home Affairs' Online Verification Service, per BusinessTech reporting the ACT's statements.
Home Affairs' National Population Register is in service, with a new cost structure for access through the Online Verification Service live from July 2025, per BusinessTech.
Network operators, banks and other companies verify customers' identities against the National Population Register through Home Affairs' Online Verification Service, per BusinessTech.
